ui.note.main:
Duas aur ayat mashhoor sahih kutub se li gayi hain.
Phir bhi kisi alim se tasdeeq karein. 🤲
ui.home.azS: Din ki shuruat Allah ke zikr se
ui.jm.title: Jumma Mubarak 🕌
ui.jm.homeOnly: Ye checklist Jumma ke din Home par aayegi.
ui.prog.title: Benamazi se Namazi
ui.prog.sub: Qadam ba qadam namaz ki aadat
ui.prog.desc: 7 marhalay — ek namaz se shuru kar ke paanchon tak, phir 40 din ki pakki aadat.
ui.prog.doneBig: Aap ne saare marhalay mukammal kar liye!
ui.prog.doneSub: Allah istiqamat de. Ab bas aadat jaari rakhein.
ui.prog.zero: Koi baat nahi, aaj se phir shuru — Allah koshish dekhta hai 💚
ui.prog.warn: Paanchon namazein farz hain. Ye sirf aadat daalne ki tarteeb hai — jo namaz reh jaaye uski qaza karein aur baaqi bhi padhne ki koshish jaari rakhein.
ui.st.0.tip: Sirf Maghrib ko pakka karein — ye sab se chhoti aur aasaan waqt wali hai.
ui.st.1.tip: Maghrib ke saath Isha jor dein. Sone se pehle padh lein.
ui.st.2.tip: Ab Fajr. Alarm lagayein, jaldi sone ki koshish karein.
ui.st.3.tip: Asr jor dein — kaam ke beech 10 minute nikaalein.
ui.st.4.tip: MashaAllah! Ab Zuhr bhi — paanchon mukammal.
ui.st.5.tip: 40 din paanchon namazein — aadat pakki ho jaati hai.
ui.st.6.tip: Farz ke saath sunnat-e-muakkadah aur jahan mumkin ho jamaat.
ui.pg.all: Aap ne poora program mukammal kar liya. Allah istiqamat de!
ui.ib.timesRef: {m} · Asr {a}. Apni masjid ke auqaat ko tarjeeh dein.
ui.sf.legend: Namaz 10 · Sunnat 10 · Azkaar 15 · Neki 5 · Muhasaba 10 · Amal 10 · Istighfar 3/33 · Jumma 5 · Qaza 5 (max 50) · Marhala +50
ui.ay.tomorrow: Kal nayi ayat aur naya amal 🌱
ui.nk.private: Neki chhupa kar karna behtar hai — ye sirf aap ke phone mein hai.
ui.nk.weekMsg: MashaAllah! Har neki ka badla kam az kam 10 guna (Al-An'am 6:160).
ui.nk.weekEmpty: Is hafte ki pehli neki aaj karein 🌱
ui.mu.quote: "Har jaan dekhe ke us ne kal ke liye kya aage bheja." — Al-Hashr 59:18
ui.mu.istRef: Nabi ﷺ din mein 100 dafa istighfar karte
ui.mu.note: Ye sirf aap ke phone par mehfooz hai. Allah se tauba ka darwaza hamesha khula hai 💚
ui.hb.dua: Ae Allah! Bure akhlaaq, bure aamaal aur buri khwahishaat se teri panah.
ui.hb.empty: Koi tracker nahi. Ek aadat chunein jo chhorni hai — sirf aap ko nazar aayegi.
ui.hb.note: "Allah ki rehmat se mayoos na ho" (Az-Zumar 39:53). Phisalna insaani hai — tauba kar ke phir uthna hi kamyabi hai.
ui.hb.slipTxt: Tauba karein: Astaghfirullah. Allah tauba karne walon se mohabbat karta hai (Al-Baqarah 2:222). Phir se shuru karein?
ui.set.title: Settings
ui.set.permDenied: Browser ne notifications block ki hain
ui.set.remNote: Note: bina server ke, reminders tab hi aate hain jab app/tab khula ho ya background mein ho.
ui.set.backupTxt: Saara data sirf is phone/browser mein hai. Backup file save kar lein.
ui.set.name: Naam
ui.fm.remoteEmpty: Doosre phone wale apna share code bhejein, yahan paste karein.
ui.fm.privacy: Sirf naam, namaz ki ginti aur streak share hoti hai — muhasaba, aadatein aur qaza kabhi nahi.
ui.fm.note:
Maqsad muqabla nahi, ek doosre ka hausla barhana hai.
"Neki aur taqwa mein ek doosre ki madad karo" — Al-Maidah 5:2
ui.cf.progOff: Program band karein? (Namaz ka record mehfooz rahega)
ui.cf.wipe: Is profile ka saara record mit jaayega. Pakka?
ui.cf.restore: Backup se saara data badal diya jaayega. Jaari rakhein?
ui.sh.code: Mera Deen Safar 🌙 — mera share code app mein "Ghar" tab par paste karein:
ui.sh.hausla:
Assalam-o-Alaikum! 🌙 Aaj ki namaz ka waqt na bhooliye ga. Allah hum sab ko istiqamat de. 🤲
— {n} (Mera Deen Safar)
ui.onb.desc: Roz ke chhote amal — namaz, sunnat, zikr aur neki — jo deen ko zindagi ka hissa bana dein.
ui.onb.name: Aap ka naam
ui.onb.note: Saara data sirf aap ke phone mein rehta hai.
ui.nt.Sb: Din ki shuruat Allah ke zikr se — 10 minute.
ui.nt.nzb: Hayya alas-salah — namaz ki taraf aao.
ui.qz.title: Qaza namaz
ui.qz.introBig: Chhooti namazon ka hisaab aur tracker
ui.qz.introTxt: Andaaza lagayein kitni namazein reh gayi, phir roz thodi thodi ada karein. Har qadam qeemti hai 🌱
ui.qz.missedN: Pichle dinon ki {n} namazein tick nahi hui.
ui.qz.emptyBig: Qaza ka safar abhi shuru nahi hua
ui.qz.emptyTxt: Pehle andaaza lagayein ke kitni namazein qaza hain, phir roz thodi thodi ada karein. Allah koshish dekhta hai 💚
ui.qz.missTxt: Pichle dinon ki kuch namazein tick nahi hui. Agar waqai chhoot gayi thi to qaza mein daal dein, aur agar padh li thi to bas chhor dein.
ui.qz.eta: Is raftar se ~{s} mein mukammal, InshaAllah
ui.qz.etaGoal: Roz {g} qaza se ~{s} mein mukammal, InshaAllah
ui.qz.complete: 🎉 Alhamdulillah! Saari qaza ada ho gayi. Allah qabool farmaye.
ui.qz.ptsRef: Har qaza +{p} points (din mein zyada se zyada {c}). Tip: har farz ke saath ek qaza padh lein, roz {d} qaza aasaani se 🌿
ui.qz.hadith: "Allah ko sab se pyara amal wo hai jo hamesha kiya jaaye, chahe thoda ho."
ui.qz.calcTxt: Andaaza lagayein ke kitne din ki namazein reh gayi. Har din = 5 farz{w}.
ui.qz.to: Baqaida namaz kab se shuru ki
ui.qz.balighHint: Baligh hone ki nishaniyan yaad na hon to aksar ulama 15 saal ki umr maante hain — kisi alim se tasdeeq karein.
ui.qz.minusHint: Wo din jin mein namazein padhi thi, ya khawateen ke haiz/nifas ke din.
ui.qz.witrHint: Hanafi fiqh mein Witr wajib hai, is ki qaza bhi hoti hai
ui.qz.resTxt: Roz {k} qaza (1 din) se ~{s} mein ada ho sakti hain, InshaAllah. Ghabrayein nahi — Allah koshish dekhta hai 💚
ui.qz.calcNote: Saal = 365 din, mahina = 30 din (andaazan). Shak ho to thoda zyada rakhna ehtiyaat hai.
ui.qz.editTxt: Agar aap ko apni ginti maloom hai to har namaz ki baaqi tadaad yahan likh dein.
ui.qz.offNote: (ada ki hui qaza ka record mehfooz rahega)
ui.qz.cfOff: Qaza tracker band karein? (Ada ki hui qaza ka record mehfooz rahega)
ui.qz.allDoneT: Alhamdulillah! Saari qaza ada ho gayi
ui.qz.allDoneS: Allah aap ki har namaz qabool farmaye aur istiqamat de.
ui.qz.mTxt: Jo namaz waqai chhoot gayi thi wo chuni rahne dein. Agar padh li thi magar tick bhool gaye to us par tap kar ke hata dein.
ui.qz.mWitr: Isha ke saath Witr bhi jud jaayegi.
ui.qz.tsMissOk: {n} namazein qaza mein shamil — Allah aasaani de 🤲
ui.qz.note1: 🕰️ Qaza kisi bhi waqt padh sakte hain, siwaye makrooh auqaat ke: Tulu (suraj nikalte waqt), Zawal (theek dopahar) aur Ghuroob (suraj doobte waqt).
ui.qz.note2: Qaza ka tareeqa aur tadaad ke liye kisi alim se tasdeeq karein. 🤲
